methodology: Explicit regional interpretation of source-labelled political association; no independent sovereignty or effective-control inference. This unsplit source composite does not establish a single sovereign kingdom; no medieval/early-modern UK or1650monarchy inferred.
Immutable 0.5° WGS84 cell membership from the unchanged Chronicle rasterizer; eligible intersection threshold 0.50. The cell geometry is authoritative.
Historical Basemaps nominal snapshot year is a possible observation window, not a dated onset or cessation. Unsupported intervening years remain gaps.
Political polygons mean source-attributed association. Cultural approximations are separately identified and do not imply ownership.

Date precision: year; Possible observation window; no exact onset or cessation inferred.
limitations: No separately named Britannia province geometry in the selected31snapshots.
Only five Heptarchy kingdom names have eligible source polygons; East Anglia and Sussex are absent as separate features.
Wales is represented by Welsh cultural approximation and broader later source composites; no Gwynedd/Powys/Wales polity polygons are invented.
200BCE and100BCE cultural coverage does not imply political ownership.
Cell threshold can omit small islands; 1 source components have no eligible cell in this assertion.
No independent corroboration or historical certification.
